meta_title: Availability and booking · Casa Rossa, Montalcino
meta_description: Availability for summer 2027 at Casa Rossa, Montalcino, and how to enquire about a stay.

hero.heading: Booking
hero.text: Seven weeks each summer, Saturday to Saturday.

availability.heading: Summer 2027
availability.text: Casa Rossa is never listed on booking sites. We let it privately, to a small number of guests each summer, and every stay is arranged directly with us. The house is available for just seven weeks, Saturday to Saturday. Arrival from 4pm, departure by 10am.

sections.title: Payment
items: A deposit of [[50%]] is due within 3 days of booking. Your booking is confirmed once the deposit is received.
The balance is due [[60]] days before arrival. For bookings made within [[60]] days of arrival, full payment is due on booking.

sections.title: Security deposit
items: A refundable security deposit of [[€2,500]] is payable by bank transfer before arrival, and returned within 14 days of departure, less the cost of any damage.

sections.title: Tourist tax
items: Montalcino's tourist tax of [[€X]] per person per night is payable separately.

sections.title: Cancellation
items: The deposit is non-refundable unless we are able to re-let your week.
The balance is non-refundable once paid.
We strongly recommend travel insurance that covers cancellation.

sections.title: Children
items: The weekly rate covers up to 10 guests, children included.
Children under 3 stay free and don't count towards the 10 if they sleep in a cot or child's bed. We have a BabyBjörn travel cot, a wooden cot and two small children's beds.

rules.heading: House rules
list: A maximum of 10 guests, with no parties or events.
Passports or ID are required for all guests, as Italian law requires us to register every guest.
No smoking indoors, and no pets.

enquire.heading: Come and stay
enquire.text: Tell us when you would like to come and who will be joining you, and we will be in touch personally. We aim to respond to all enquiries within 24 hours.
